q1_issues.issue: The eventive/inchoative "will get married to" (a future wedding) is encoded as the stative relation (Future (Married lucy sk_singer_1)) with no event reified, whereas the routing rule reserves the relation + Symmetric form for stative symmetric predicates and sends eventive symmetric verbs to a collective event.

q2_gaps: inchoative entry into a symmetric stative relation ("get married to", "become friends with") — the routing note covers stative symmetric predicates and eventive collective verbs but not the transition into a symmetric state

epistemic certainty adverbs ("definitely", "certainly", "surely") — no operator; the Truth-values line maps "definitely" to strength 1.0, which is also the default, so the word leaves no trace in the parse
notes: Married/Symmetric is the instruction set's own listed symmetric predicate, so the head itself is licensed; the compound pop_singer correctly gets its genus and no modifier genus (noun modifier).
